statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-80255: a Set-Cookie header that has a tab instead of a space just before the Secure attribute makes curl store the cookie without its Secure flag, so it might later be sent over plain HTTP to the same host (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-80255.html). curl lists it as affecting releases from 8.13.0, with 8.17.0 through 8.21.0 affected on the current release line, and fixed it in curl 8.22.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/4f6aa41a0145e930e766775dbe860883d350aa0a, which is in the curl-8_22_0 release tag and not in curl-8_21_0. Alpine also lists it as fixed in curl 8.22.0-r0 (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-80255). The DHI Alpine curl package is built from Alpine's aports curl recipe at the upstream curl release, and its build definition carries no patch for this CVE. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, on x86_64 and aarch64, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. None of the builds before 8.22.0-r0 is based on curl 8.22.0 or later, so 8.22.0-r0, the first build of curl 8.22.0, is the first fixed build.
